project_summary: The Maryland Health Benefit Exchange (MHBE) is soliciting bids for a 12-month subscription to PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC). This procurement aims to secure various identity and access management licenses, including customer and workforce identity services, along with associated premium support, training, onboarding, and professional services, to support MHBE's operations as an independent State government unit facilitating health insurance enrollment.

items.name: PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Customer Identity Subscriptions
items.reason: To provide 600,000 active customer identity subscriptions for PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Customer Core, Access Plus, Sync, Protect - Customer Identities (Standard), and Edge services for a 12-month period (September 1, 2026 - August 31, 2027), including specified environments and reporting capabilities.

items.name: PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Workforce Identity Subscriptions
items.reason: To provide 500 workforce identity subscriptions for PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Workforce Core, Access Management, Edge Security Passwordless Enterprise Connect, Protect - Workforce Identities (Standard), and Edge services for a 12-month period (September 1, 2026 - August 31, 2027), including specified environments and reporting capabilities.

items.name: PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Additional Sandbox Environments
items.reason: To provide 2 additional sandbox environment subscriptions, including one for the 12-month contract term (September 1, 2026 - August 31, 2027) and a no-charge one for the pre-contract month (August 1, 2026 - August 31, 2026).

items.name: Ping Customer Care Package - Premium Tier
items.reason: To provide a Premium Customer Care Package as further described in the Support Policy for the subscription term.

items.name: All Access Training Subscription
items.reason: To provide a top-tier training subscription, including public instructor-led training, for the subscription term.

items.name: ForgeRock Identity Cloud Onboarding - Foundations
items.reason: To provision a PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud tenant, additional tenant, a sandbox, or additional UAT environments and set up the designated administrator role.

items.name: Professional Services - Pre-Paid (80 hours)
items.reason: To provide 80 hours of pre-paid professional services available in 1-hour blocks, to be used and completed by the end of the term dates indicated.

items.name: Bid Submission (PDF via eMMA)
items.reason: MHBE strongly desires eMMA delivery of Bids, which must be submitted in pdf format and clearly labeled, by the specified due date and time.

items.name: Transmittal Letter
items.reason: A Transmittal Letter must accompany the Bid, acknowledging receipt of addenda and signed by an individual authorized to commit the Bidder to the services and requirements.

items.name: Minimum Qualification Documentation (Letter of Authorization)
items.reason: Bidder must be authorized to resell PingOne subscription and submit a letter of authorization from the manufacturer as proof.

items.name: Bid Price Form (Attachment D)
items.reason: The Bid must contain all price information in the format specified on IFB Attachment D - Bid Form, completed strictly according to pricing instructions.

items.name: Required Affidavits & Federal Forms (Attachments B, E, E-1, E-2)
items.section_ref: Section 4.2.4, Attachments B, E, E-1, E-2
items.reason: Must be completed and submitted with the Bid, including the Bid Proposal Affidavit, Federal Funds Attachment, and Certification Against Lobbying, to provide necessary certifications and disclosures.

items.name: PIA Redacted Copy
items.reason: A second attachment labeled 'PIA' in searchable Adobe .pdf format, with confidential and/or proprietary information removed, must be submitted for Public Information Act requests.

items.name: Pre-Bid Conference Response Form
items.reason: To indicate attendance for the virtual Pre-Bid Conference on Tuesday, July 7, 2026, and specify any reasonable accommodations requested.

items.name: Standard Contract (Attachment A)
items.reason: Must be signed and submitted electronically within five (5) Business Days of notification of proposed Contract award.

items.name: Contract Affidavit (Attachment C)
items.reason: Must be completed and submitted electronically within five (5) Business Days of notification of proposed Contract award.

checklist.reason: Payment terms are NET30, which meets the 'NET30 or better' criteria.
checklist.evidence: Section 4.2 (page 18): 'Payments to the Contractor shall be made no later than thirty (30) days after the MHBE’s receipt of a proper invoice...'

checklist.reason: Specific dollar amounts for insurance requirements are not mentioned in the RFP text. This requires clarification.
checklist.evidence: Section 22.4 (page 26) states 'The Contractor ... shall obtain, at its expense, all licenses, permits, insurance, and governmental approvals, if any, necessary to the performance of its obligations under this Contract.' No specific monetary limits are provided.

checklist.reason: Assuming our company meets the financial stability required to bid on and execute a contract of this potential value and scope, as no specific external financial benchmarks were stipulated in the RFP for bidders.
checklist.evidence: Implicit assumption based on the nature of the bid; RFP does not specify external financial stability metrics for bidders.

checklist.reason: The RFP is a Firm Fixed Price contract and requires the bidder to submit a Total Bid Price, but the client's specific budget for the project is not disclosed, making it vague.
checklist.evidence: Key Information Summary Sheet (page 2) and Section 6 (page 14): 'The Contract that results from this IFB shall be a firm fixed price contract.' Attachment D - Bid Price Form requires bidders to submit 'TOTAL BID PRICE'.

checklist.reason: No bid bond requirement is mentioned in the RFP text.
checklist.evidence: RFP text does not contain any mention of a bid bond.

checklist.reason: The critical eligibility criterion is the authorization to resell PingOne products/services, which is assumed to be met by our company.
checklist.evidence: Section 3 (page 10): 'The Bidder must be authorized to resell subscription of Ping One. As proof, the Bidder must submit with the bid a letter of authorization from the manufacturer providing evidence of the rights to resell all products and services required by this IFB.'

checklist.reason: Certification of registration or qualification with the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation is required. Assuming our company has or can easily ensure this registration is current and in good standing.
checklist.evidence: Attachment C - Contract Affidavit, Section B (page 39): 'CERTIFICATION OF REGISTRATION OR QUALIFICATION WITH THE STATE DEPARTMENT OF ASSESSMENTS AND TAXATION'.

checklist.reason: E-Verify or similar employee verification programs are not mentioned as a requirement in the RFP.
checklist.evidence: RFP text does not contain any mention of E-Verify.

checklist.reason: The contract (Attachment A) contains extensive legal terms including complex liability clauses (e.g., '3 times the value of the Contract' liability limit for some claims, but 'unlimited if the State is not immune' for others, such as intellectual property infringement, bodily injury, real/tangible property damage) and federal funding requirements (CFDA number 93.778). These require thorough legal review by our legal department.
checklist.evidence: Attachment A - CONTRACT (pages 16-30), specifically Section 25 'Liability For breach...' (page 27) and Section 30 'Federal Funds Requirements and Restrictions' (page 28).

checklist.reason: The RFP requires compliance with extensive federal, state, and local laws, and federal funding requirements (Medicaid Funds, CFDA number 93.778, ACA, Civil Rights, Byrd Anti-Lobbying Amendment). Assuming our company has standard compliance programs in place for government contracts.
checklist.evidence: Section 22 (page 26) 'Compliance with Laws'; Attachment B (pages 31-38) 'BID PROPOSAL AFFIDAVIT'; Attachment E (pages 49-50) 'FEDERAL FUNDS ATTACHMENT'.

checklist.reason: Several specific attachments (B, D, E, E-1, E-2 with bid; A, C upon award) are required. While generally standard for government bids, these forms will require dedicated effort and attention to detail for accurate completion.
checklist.evidence: Section 4.2.4 (page 12) 'Completed Required Attachments' lists Attachment B, E, E-1, E-2 for submission with the bid. Section 4.4 (page 14) lists Attachment A, C for submission within 5 business days upon notice of recommendation for award.

checklist.reason: The bid submission deadline is exactly 30 days from the issue date, which is feasible according to our checklist.
checklist.evidence: Issue Date: June 16, 2026. Closing Date and Time: 11:00 AM EST on July 16, 2026 (Key Information Summary Sheet, page 2 and Section 4.1.2, page 11).

checklist.reason: Standard signatory authority from an authorized representative is required for the bid and contract documents, which is assumed to be available within the company.
checklist.evidence: Section 4.2.1 (page 11) 'Transmittal Letter...signed by an individual who is authorized to commit the Bidder...'; Attachment A (page 30) 'Signature page to Ping One Advanced Identity Subscription'.

checklist.reason: Registration on eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) is required. Assuming the company is already registered or can register promptly to meet this.
checklist.evidence: Section 4.1.6 (page 11): 'Bidders must submit their bids via eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA). If you have not already registered on eMMA, please use the following link...'

checklist.reason: The scope is perfectly aligned as it's a specific procurement for 'PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC) subscription' with 16 distinct line items listing exact products and quantities.
checklist.evidence: Section 2.1 (page 6) 'Purpose...to subscribe to PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC) for a 12-month period.' Section 2.2 (pages 6-9) details 16 specific PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud products/services and quantities.

checklist.reason: The technical requirements are explicitly defined by a list of 16 specific PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud licenses and services, along with quantities. Assuming our authorization to resell covers all specified items, we meet all requirements.
checklist.evidence: Section 2.2 (pages 6-9) lists the 16 specific PingOne products and their quantities. Section 3 (page 10) requires authorization to resell 'all products and services required by this IFB'.

checklist.reason: The RFP is for specific PingOne software licenses. Compliance with relevant industry standards for identity management solutions (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML) is inherent to the specified PingOne platform itself.
checklist.evidence: Section 2.1 (page 6) 'Purpose...to subscribe to PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC)...' and Section 2.2 (pages 6-9) detailing the specific PingOne products.

checklist.reason: The security requirements are implicitly tied to the robust security standards of the PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud platform, which is assumed to be appropriate for government use. No additional explicit security requirements are listed for the bidder.
checklist.evidence: Section 2.1 (page 6) 'Purpose...to subscribe to PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC)...' relies on the inherent security features of the specified product.

checklist.reason: The scope of professional services explicitly states exclusions like 'design, configuration, or implementation assistance' for onboarding (item 12) and 'No custom software or development included' (item 13). This indicates that specific integration work is out of scope for this particular bid.
checklist.evidence: Section 2.2, S.No 12 (page 8) 'FIPCloudOnboarding - Foundation' description: 'Excludes design, configuration, or implementation assistance.' S.No 13 (page 9) 'Professional Services - Pre-Paid' description: 'No custom software or development included.'

go_no_go.summary: We should proceed with this bid. The core technical and scope alignment is excellent, assuming our company is an authorized PingOne reseller and can meet the minimum qualification. There are three items that require escalation for internal review or clarification: unstated insurance requirements, vagueness regarding the client's budget (standard for fixed-price bids but noted for internal planning), and a thorough legal review of the extensive contract terms.
